My goal is to schedule a 30-minute meeting for four partners next week. I can see the calendars for Priya Raman and Marcus Hale, while my partner, Brad, can see the calendars for Elena Soto and David Okafor.

My first step is to gather the availability for the partners I have access to. I'll use the `read_calendar` tool for both Priya and Marcus.

Once I have their busy times, I need to communicate this information to Brad through our shared workspace. This will allow him to check for a time that works for all four partners.

My plan for this session is:
1. Read Priya Raman's calendar.
2. Read Marcus Hale's calendar.
3. Post the busy times for both to the shared workspace for Brad to use.
4. End my session to allow Brad to take his turn.

This is the most efficient way to start, as it immediately gets the ball rolling on finding a common availability. I will be sure to clearly label the information I post to the workspace to avoid any confusion.
